tasksNotApplicable.build: Ships index.mjs as-is: a private, workspace-only ESM config imported directly from source by each package's eslint.config.mjs. There is nothing to compile or bundle.
tasksNotApplicable.test: No unit tests of its own. The factory is exercised end-to-end by every workspace that lints -- tokens, vitest-preset and this package all import it, and their lint task fails if it throws or returns an invalid config.
tasksNotApplicable.typecheck: Plain ESM JavaScript, no TypeScript sources; the annotations are JSDoc only. `tsc --checkJs` does not pass today because the exported rule-config literals widen (fallbackSort.type widens to string), which needs the source annotated with @satisfies. Left declared rather than papered over with a script that checks nothing.
